notes: Memory/IndexedDB-shaped are Node SDK + wasm; IDB is fake-indexeddb 6.2.5, not browser or disk evidence.
Cadence trials use an isolated built-package copy with 100 ms instead of 250 ms; production is unchanged.
Peak heap is sampled heapUsed; external includes wasm. GC checkpoints after close are separate from peak timing.
SS_FAKE_RECLAIM is a diagnostic control removing only finished fake transactions after each save; not a production SDK fix.
Full-suite compilation overlaps the diagnostic experiments. Raw payloads remain under target/lane-ss-round1.
heap-final runs put acquisition in a completed async function so its lexical locals are released before post-close GC; earlier heap runs are retained as exploratory evidence.
